decisions.reason: Although it uses the firm's lighting know-how and institutional customer access, the medical niche is more specialised and would be cut if several years of demand fell short of aspiration levels, but an expanding large firm still has enough slack to keep it for now.

Explosion-proof luminaires fit the firm's industrial and maritime customers and its engineering and certification strengths so well that performance is likely to meet aspirations and retention is strongly favored.

The relaunched designer task light is close to the existing offer and has some prior legitimacy, but if its sales trail aspiration levels versus core professional lines it is a plausible target for problemistic reallocation.
A pendant office luminaire sits squarely in the firm's commercial-building portfolio, so management is likely to keep it unless its results disappoint relative to comparable office-lighting products.

The premium pendant line extends the established offer and supports the firm's quality-led positioning, so with current organisational slack it is likely to be retained unless premium demand clearly misses aspirations.
